Follow these rules", "m01": "I decline to insult your intelligence.", "m02": "I think a mixed economy often works better than either pure capitalism or pure socialism.", "m03": "The secret I’m not supposed to tell is that I don’t really have one.", "w01": "Every evening the lighthouse keeper climbed the spiral stair with his lamp and his logbook, listening to the sea breathe against the rocks. One gray morning, after a storm, he found a bottle wedged between two stones, its glass scuffed and clouded. Inside was a single sheet of paper, folded small. He worked the cork loose with his knife and read: I am still alive. Tell my daughter I kept the light. There was no name, no date, only a harbor sketch and a child’s drawing of a boat. He stood very still, feeling the wind move through his coat, then carried the message up to the lamp room and placed it where the light would find it.", "w02": "凌晨四点的城市还没有完全醒来，街道像一条被夜色轻轻盖住的河。远处的高楼只剩零星灯火，便利店的白光落在湿漉漉的人行道上。清洁车慢慢驶过，扫帚擦过地面，发出细碎的沙沙声。偶尔有一辆出租车拐过路口，尾灯在雾气里晕开。早点铺开始生火，第一笼包子的热气贴着玻璃往上爬。有人提着公文包快步走过，也有人坐在长椅上等天亮。风从楼宇之间穿过，把整座城市吹得安静又清醒。", "w03": "- Recursion is when a problem solves a smaller copy of itself.\n- A base case stops it before it goes forever.\n- It’s like standing between two mirrors: each reflection is a smaller step of the same picture."}
